card.name: Start of a medical term after a break
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long medical word that begins right after a section number, heading or comma, such as Intr(avenous), Ch(olinergic), Ch(ondrolysis). Also fires on a comma inside a list of organ functions.

modes.label: Word start after heading
modes.description: Opening piece of a split medical word such as Intr or Ch right after a section number or heading label.

modes.label: Word start mid-sentence
modes.description: Opening piece of a split word like ch or intr inside running text.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed code and foreign-language pieces, so there is no clear output effect beyond a weak push toward word continuation.
card.plain: It lights up on the first chunk of a long medical word like intravenous or cholinergic, just before the rest of the word follows.
